description:
A 10-inch electric scooter equipped with a powerful 500W motor, dual shock absorbers for enhanced comfort, and a high-quality dual brake system. It features a long-range battery, three-speed modes, and a convenient one-step folding design, making it an excellent choice for daily commuting.

Other Special Features of the Product: Cruise Control, Digital Display, Dual Braking System, Foldable, Lightweight

Measurements

Item Dimensions L x W x H: 44.5"L x 16.9"W x 48.8"H

🛴【Powerful Motor & Long Range】The electric scooter for adults with a 500W brushless hub motor allows for speed up to 22mph. High-capacity rechargeable and replaceable battery (42V/10.5Ah) has a max range of 22 miles under certain conditions. The max load is 265 lbs so it can meet the difference needs of teenagers and adults.

🛴【Dual Suspension and 10” Solid Tire】The 10”honeycomb tires, along with the shock absorbing system, make this electric scooter adults for a smooth and comfortable ride even on rough surfaces while the tires don't require additional maintenance or repair. Compared with other ordinary 87.5-inch tires, 10-inch tires have stronger obstacle crossing capabilities and better shock absorption effects.

🛴【Ride Safety】This e scooter product is UL 2272 tested. The e-scooter has a dual braking system, front brake is EABS regenerative anti-lock brake, and rear brake is drum brake. it also with non slip deck, so it is safer to ride. Also, the e-scooter for teens & adults has super bright LED headlight and brake tail light for better visibility and riding safety.

🛴【LED Display & Smart Control &Lockable】You can check your speed, modes and battery level on the LED digital display. check and control the electric scooter's features via your cell phone, such as checking cruise control, speedometer, unlocking or locking the scooter and more. It works with both iPhone and Android smartphones.

🛴【Portable&Lightweight Design】The adult electric scooters can be folded in seconds and stored in car trunks, offices and other places to save space. This scooter is made of aluminum and weighs only 36 pounds, so you can easily take this foldable scooter to subways and buses.

🛴【Warming Tips】 The first initial charge is 6 hours. Each subsequent charge time is no more than 5 hours. Users should regularly check the condition of the battery and charging device, to ensure that the matching battery is used and the correct charging method is used, and avoid charging in an unventilated or flammable environment. Our FLYPKIN e-scooters provide one-year warranty, if you have any problem with your product, we will reply within 24 hours.

🛴【Start Mode Tip】If the throttle does not respond, please check the start mode in the APP settings. Only when you select zero start, the motor will start when you press the throttle. If you select a non-zero start, you must coast first.
